items.text: Linux single-window mode: closing a workspace keeps the one window - the one on show hands it to the one shown before it, the toplevel's close button closes the workspace on show, and the last close closes the window.
Linux single-window mode: the window reports the most urgent activity of all its workspaces, and a parked workspace waiting on a question marks the window urgent.
Linux chrome titles at the Mac's semibold: header-bar title, .heading, strip labels, guide badges and the picked theme tile draw at 600, not Adwaita's bold.
label-weights.sh finds the header title by its text: AdwWindowTitle's .title label sits in a box, not directly in windowtitle.
label-weights.sh B6 names the reload reply and the custom-css log lines.
label-weights.sh reloads with +reload --config, the verb's config form.
The commit guard no longer leaves the shared tree mid-rebase when its pull hits the other window's index.lock.
